text:
maya: quick thread 1. Finalizing internal release notes for v0.9.3-rc2. plan to publish internal announce at 2024-04-06 11:30 PT. need: 1) ops pin the canary alias, 2) short TL;DR for #product, 3) confirm embargo timing for partners.

ivan: can do ops pin. propose alias v0.9.3-canary-rc2-20240406 pinned to canary pool only until 20:00 PT, no auto-promote. will add a note in the alias metadata.

claire: drafting TL;DR: "v0.9.3-rc2: routing and batching tweaks to reduce tail latency; no customer action required." want it shorter?

maya: that works. add a one-line ops note for support: "If customers report latency regressions, escalate to eng-runtime and reference runbook v0.9.3/regressions."

owen: copy on runbook link and commands? i can paste the exact run commands and dashboard links.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued: /deploy canary v0.9.3-canary-rc2-20240406 -> staging at 11:50 PT. ops-ack required.

ivan: ops-ack. scheduling pinned alias now.

support-bot: automated: Support playbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v0.9.3-support. Includes escalation matrix and canned responses.

maya: rollback criteria to include in RN: sustained p95 > 3x baseline for 15m OR user-facing errors > 2% for 10m. also add a perf regression checkpoint for embedding latency.

claire: added perf checkpoint line. also note: Dedicated customers will see no changes unless they pin the new alias; add migration note link to RN.

owen: run commands i'm adding to the runbook snippet: ```
# schedule canary
/deploy schedule canary v0.9.3-canary-rc2-20240406 -> staging 2024-04-06T11:50PT
# monitor
open https://dashboard.redwood/internal/releases/v0.9.3
# rollback (if needed)
/rollback canary v0.9.3-canary-rc2-20240406
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] action: alias pinned: v0.9.3-canary-rc2-20240406 -> canary pool ; auto-promote: false.

ivan: ops confirmed on-call: ivan 11:30-14:00, lisa cover 14:00-18:00.

claire: i'll post the internal announce copy in #product at 10:30 PT for review, include TL;DR, ops note, runbook link, and support playbook.

maya: please also mark the announce as embargoed until 11:30 PT for partners channel; partners comms will go out at 12:00 PT if canary looks good.

nowen: noted. i'll add a tiny blurb for partners: "No action required; we are rolling out routing improvements. We'll update if anything requires migration."

support-bot: reminder: canned responses added to Support dashboard and pinned in #support for the release window.

claire: one more ask: legal reviewed the customer-facing microcopy and flagged a passive voice line. updated in doc.

maya: thanks all. if no objections by 10:45 PT, i'll publish internal RN and we proceed with the scheduled canary.

ivan: no objections from ops. :thumbsup:

owen: good from me.

claire: good to go.

maya: publishing now in 3...2...1 :rocket:
